about_the_game:
Mouse Fart is a RPG style game in which you will navigate a randomized maze in search of food items to collect.  You will always have a dog as your trusty Companion. It's populated by different Food Monsters you will have to fight in combat.

Choose between different attacks in turn-based combat. Master quick-time events to deal higher damage and block attacks. A dog will give you company in the combat and represent the bulk of your main offensive and defensive capabilities.

The food you collect is taken with you home where you can eat it. Produce different colorful clouds that you can now light and generate over 70 different authentic fart sounds. Discover combinations of food to unlock special effects within the clouds which are stored in jars on the shelves for your repeat viewing enjoyment. Totally not creepy at all!

Unlock rats as another main character and 4 more dog characters as companion to choose from. Gain experience from all actions, level up and gather skill points to enhance your characters. Choose between 3 different soundtrack styles: Cartoon, Epic, and Jazz. Explore various secrets to free the Goddess and fight the boss Vulcan.

With this game, it's OK to have your head in the clouds!
